title: AuthorityChangedPayload
description: Payload of the AuthorityChanged event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2853 (T9); grant, consent and principal records added by INV-T-3298 (INV-API-3325, INV-Q-3322 (b), INV-Q-3339). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required. One event carries exactly one record: a grantRecord (changeKind GRANT), a consentRecord (changeKind CONSENT) or a principalRecord (changeKind PRINCIPAL deletion, or REVOCATION), each keyed on its own and versioned by this event's authorityVersion. An event that carries none of the three (a 1.0-shaped event) has no grant state: an authority replica drops what it holds for that principal and denies, never keeps it, so a revoke can never be lost (INV-REQ-1214). principalKind is never on the wire: the replica takes it from the propagated token (INV-REQ-1202 b2, INV-Q-3259).

changeKind.description: What kind of authority change this is.

validity.description: The validity window of the change.

to.description: End of validity, absent when open-ended.

authorityVersion.description: Monotonic authority version this change advances to: one access-svc sequence, drawn after access-svc locks the principal row (or, for a consent record, the consent row) in the change's transaction, so versions per key follow commit order (TPL-05). It is the version of the one record this event carries; a replica ignores a record at or below the version it holds for that record's key and measures its lag against the newest version seen (INV-REQ-1201 b1).

grantRecord.description: Present when changeKind is GRANT: the full grant state, after the change, of one (tenant, principalRef, entityRef), replacing whole whatever a replica holds for that key (INV-Q-3322 (b), INV-REQ-864). The tenant is the envelope's tenantid (API-40). Tenant and group grants are expanded by access-svc into one grant record per entity under the scope, and re-emitted when an entity is created, moved or retired under it; a replica never resolves a scope through its structure replica. A change touching N entities emits N events in one outbox transaction.

entityRef.description: The registered entity this grant state is for.

grants.description: Every action the principal holds on entityRef after the change, one entry per action and scope. An empty list is an explicit removal: the replica keeps it as a tombstone with its authorityVersion, so an older redelivered record cannot bring the grant back.

items.description: One action granted on entityRef, with the scope it was granted under and its validity window.

action.description: The action granted, as named in access-svc's action catalogue.

scopeLevel.description: The scope level of the grant this action comes from (INV-REQ-864 b1, INV-Q-3339): TENANT, GROUP, ENTITY, ENTITY_PERIOD or CONSENT. Kept for audit; TENANT and GROUP grants arrive already expanded to entityRef. Fail-closed: a replica denies any scopeLevel it does not recognise and never reads it as a plain ENTITY grant. ENTITY covers every period; ENTITY_PERIOD covers only periodFrom..periodTo; CONSENT needs, in addition, a live consentRecord for entityRef (INV-REQ-865).

scopeRef.description: Reference of the grant's scope: the tenant, group, entity or consent the grant was made on (kept for audit).

periodFrom.description: ENTITY_PERIOD only, and then always present: first day of the first granted GST accounting period. A date, never a period name, since the filing frequency can change (INV-Q-3339, INV-AC-1911). An ENTITY_PERIOD entry without periodFrom and periodTo matches nothing.

periodTo.description: ENTITY_PERIOD only, and then always present: last day of the last granted GST accounting period. A request matches only when its whole period lies inside periodFrom..periodTo, independently of the validity window.

periodRefs.description: ENTITY_PERIOD only: references of the granted periods, for display only; never used to decide.

items.description: One granted period's reference, as displayed.

validFrom.description: Start of this action's validity window.

validUntil.description: End of this action's validity window, absent when open-ended.

consentRecord.description: Present when changeKind is CONSENT: the full state, after the change, of the agent consent for one client entity, keyed (tenant, clientEntityRef) and replacing whole whatever a replica holds for that key (INV-REQ-853 b1, INV-REQ-865, INV-Q-3136). A decision under a CONSENT-scoped grant needs both the grant and a live consent record, so a withdrawal takes effect with no grant-revocation step.

clientEntityRef.description: The client entity the consent covers.

state.description: LIVE or WITHDRAWN. A withdrawal is irreversible; a new consent is a new record (INV-REQ-865 b4). Fail-closed: a replica treats any value other than LIVE as not live.

scopeItems.description: The consent's scope items, as recorded on the consent (INV-REQ-853 b1).

validUntil.description: End of the consent's validity, absent when open-ended.

principalRecord.description: Present when changeKind is PRINCIPAL (a deletion) or REVOCATION: a principal-level record keyed (tenant, principalRef). Its revocation version is this event's authorityVersion, and it voids every grant record of the principal with a lower version; a reinstated principal gets no old grant back, only new grant records with higher versions (INV-Q-3322, INV-REQ-865 b4).
